Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference for search relevance

Hi Marissa,

I signed up for a trial on your site and wanted to see about a quick demo to understand how Redwood could help with relevance ranking for our product search. A few quick details: 
- Use case: Improve relevance + reranking for category and product queries; want better long-tail performance
- Current traffic: ~120k queries/day across all storefronts (peaks at ~8k q/hr)
- Throughput need: near-real-time scoring with <150ms P95 per request if possible
- Timeline: evaluating tools now, aiming to pick a vendor in the next 4-6 weeks

Would love 30 minutes this week or early next to see a short walk-through and discuss integration patterns. My team (search-team@acme-retail.com) will join.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson 
Head of Search Engineering
Acme Retail

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for signing up. Happy to run through a short demo and tailor it to your ranking needs. Before we lock a time, two quick qualification items so I can pull the right materials and include the best engineers: 
1) Is the 120k q/day figure across all stores or just the canonical storefront? Any breakdown by region?
2) Are you planning to run inference in-hosted (Redwood hosted API) or on dedicated/private infra?
3) Do you have any security/compliance requirements we should be aware of (SOC2, IP restrictions, VPC)?
4) Are you evaluating latency-first or cost-first tradeoffs (or both)?

Proposed 30-min slots (PST):
- Mon Mar 2, 10:00–10:30
- Tue Mar 3, 09:00–09:30
- Tue Mar 3, 14:00–14:30

I've attached a short calendar availability file and a one-pager checklist to make the call productive. Please reply with the slot that works or propose a different time and include answers to the bullets above — that will help me invite the right SE.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below: 
1) 120k/day is total across US & EU storefronts; roughly 75% US, 25% EU. 
2) We're open to both hosted and dedicated options; security and SLA are the priority — we may need dedicated or private for production.
3) We require SOC2 compliance and prefer VPC/private deployment for sensitive datasets.
4) Both — low latency on critical query paths, but cost matters for long-tail ranking.

The Tue Mar 3 09:00–09:30 PST slot works for me, but I may need to shift if another conflict pops up. If it helps, I can send a calendar invite for that time.

Also: could you add a short section on typical integration time (weeks) and data requirements? That will help our procurement folks.

Thanks,
Alex
